Sir,

concerning Mr. G. A. Speransky Arkadieff.

Sir,

Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

File No.
CENTRAL I. B. □□□□
Date March 4, 1929

Subject (in full) G. A. Spektor Arkadieff.

Made by D. J. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by

With reference to the attached file re Mr. G.A.
Spektor Arkadieff, who resides at 695 Avenue Joffre, I beg to
report that there is nothing in Police records concerning him.
A similar letter was received by the French Police who have
submitted a letter to the Consul-General for the Netherlands
giving the result of their investigations.

N. Ovsianikoff
D. J.

To D.C.I.

HR. 4 3/29

6. I. S. Reg.
Please draft a reply in the
usual terms, ignoring the statement
about a similar letter having been sent
to the French Police.
JMc.
4/3/29

No. 601
SHANGHAI, 25th February 1929.

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr.G.A.Spektor
Arkadieff, a Russian subject, has applied for a visa to the
Netherlands Indies. He is said to be a partner of the
Avenue Haig Riding School, and is now proceeding to Java
as travelling representative of the Commercial and Credit
Information Bureau, 24-a Yuen Ping Yuen Road. He lives at
No.695 Avenue Joffre.

I would be much obliged for any information as to,
politics or morals, which you may have with regard to this
person.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
Consul-General.

The Director of Criminal Investigation,
S.M.P.,
SHANGHAI.
pages.zh:
第601号
上海，1929年2月25日。

先生：

谨此告知，俄国侨民G.A.Spektor Arkadieff先生已申请前往荷属东印度的签证。据称他是海格路马术学校的合伙人，现作为位于源平园路24-a号的商业与信用信息局的旅行代表前往爪哇。他居住在霞飞路695号。

如您掌握有关此人的政治或道德方面的任何信息，我将不胜感激。

此致
敬礼

您的恭顺仆人，
总领事。

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事调查处处长，
上海。
